event.tourney.rule.3: {{count}} fights per day, one level per win
event.tourney.rule.4: {{count}} free resets. Resets give you enough XP to get back to your current level
event.tourney.rule.5: A tournament round will be played every day until only one brute remains
event.tourney.rule.6: The winner will keep its destiny, reset to level 1 and become a regular brute
event.tourney.rule.7: All other brutes will be permanently deleted
event.tourney.rule.8: The next event will start {{count}} days after the end of the current event
event.tourney.rule.9: Every event has a random maximum level, the current event maximum level is {{count}}
event.battleRoyale.rule.3: {{count}} moves per day. Arena fights are disabled
event.battleRoyale.rule.4: You can scout every hour to update the tiles around you with up to date data
event.battleRoyale.rule.5: Brutes are split in groups of {{count}}, each on its own randomly generated circular map
event.battleRoyale.rule.6: Opponents are hidden outside of your vision. Perks that grant levels or vision can be found on the map
event.battleRoyale.rule.7: Brutes fight when they end up on the same tile. The loser is eliminated, the winner gains a level
event.battleRoyale.rule.8: The map tightens every day, brutes left outside of it are eliminated
event.battleRoyale.rule.9: Once every map is resolved, survivors are regrouped on new maps and keep their levels, until only one brute remains
event.battleRoyale.rule.10: The next event will start {{count}} days after the end of the current event
event.battleRoyale.rule.11: Every event has a random maximum level, the current event maximum level is {{count}}
br.resolved: Your map is resolved, wait for the next round
br.visionPerkNotice: Vision increased by {{count}}, the surroundings were scouted
br.dangerTile: Will be eliminated at the next resize
noEvent: There is no event ongoing, come back later!
